name: Travel & Tourism
description: Airlines, OTAs, hotels, booking engines, loyalty, and itinerary data at global scale
rules: PNR and passenger data treated as regulated PII with regional residency controls
Inventory and fare changes must be near-real-time; stale caches require alerting
Loyalty points and currency conversions use immutable ledger-style reconciliation
Cancellation/refund pipelines must be idempotent across GDS and payment systems
memories: Peak booking windows (holidays, events) need auto-scale on Glue/Spark workers
Amadeus/Sabre feeds often drift on ancillary product schemas — versioned contracts required
